words.example: The title on her desk card should say senior clerk.
words.exampleZh: 她桌牌上的职务名称应该写资深文员。

words.example: Her reporting line goes straight to the front-desk supervisor.
words.exampleZh: 她的汇报关系直接对到前台主管。

words.example: He also has a dotted line into the project office.
words.exampleZh: 他同时还向项目办做虚线汇报。

words.example: Her solid line goes to the information-center director.
words.exampleZh: 她的实线汇报对象是信息中心主任。

words.example: His span of control now covers twelve clerks at registration.
words.exampleZh: 他现在的管理幅度覆盖挂号处的十二名文员。

words.example: The degraded array is still serving images, but a second disk failure would stop it.
words.exampleZh: 降级阵列还在出图像，但再坏一块盘它就会停。

words.example: Pull the failed disk from slot four only after the hot spare has finished rebuilding.
words.exampleZh: 等热备盘重建完，再从四号槽拔出故障磁盘。

words.example: Predictive failure on disk two means we should replace it before the array degrades.
words.exampleZh: 二号盘已经预警故障，应该在阵列降级之前把它换掉。

words.meaning: 磁盘健康监测（Self-Monitoring, Analysis and Reporting Technology）
words.example: SMART (Self-Monitoring, Analysis and Reporting Technology) flagged disk two a week before it failed.
words.exampleZh: SMART（磁盘健康监测）在二号盘坏掉前一周就报了警。

words.example: A growing bad sector count on disk five is why that virtual disk feels slow.
words.exampleZh: 五号盘的坏扇区越来越多，那块虚拟磁盘因此变慢。
